review_description: Our experience from start to finish has been amazing! Our consultant Adrian was extremely professional and very helpful in answering all our questions and providing design options for the most effective results. The admin team provided great communication. The installation arrived on time, made introductions, clearly explained the installation process and demonstrated the system and APP. We are very happy first time solar owners. Thank you Solar Power Direct for a fabulous experience and product!

Solar Power Direct was the easiest company I dealt with going through finding a solar system for the house very professional and not pushyFrom the outset dealing with Steve he answered my multiple questions on inverters, panels and best setups/configurations and what would work bestThe lads installing were polite and very professional and nothing was a hassleA few changes had to be made on the day due to roof footprint but they sat down and explained what they had to do and whyDo date the system has worked flawlessly since install in April and meeting my expectationsI would not hesitate in recommending them

Solar Power Direct exceeded all expectations! Kyle in pre-sales was exceptional, patiently working through various scenarios and answering all my questions without hesitation given the layout and formations of our home. His expertise made me confident in choosing them.The installation was flawless. The team arrived on time, worked efficiently, and maintained a clean site throughout. They were respectful, professional, and clearly communicated the process.From start to finish, Solar Power Direct demonstrated outstanding customer service and technical expertise making the the entire experience smooth and hassle-free.I highly recommend Solar Power Direct for anyone considering solar installation. They truly set the standard for quality and customer satisfaction in the industry.

We installed our panels almost 6 years ago, and the invertor just failed. We called Solar Power Direct and they organised replacement and install in just over a week. No fuss, No cost to us. All done underwatranty. The constantly communicated with us. Customer service was excellent. Our friends have used diffcompanies who are disinterested post install. Not these guys. I highly recommend them. Even after I trail solar they followed up about a year later to check in.
Everyone was fantastic at solar direct from the office team to the guys that installed. Everyone was super helpful and answered all of my questions.

My dealings with solar direct started with the sales rep who was quick to respond to my queries  and to get back with the quote. The installation process was also good they where punctual, quick to explain and left job clean and tidy.

The salesman was very thorough. Really drilled into our requirements, then provided 5 different options (originally 4, then added another), explaining the pros and cons of each one.The installers were super polite, professional, thorough and cleaned up after themselves - we ended up giving them a dozen beers as a thank you for their efforts!There were a couple of minor hiccups in the process re: warranty paperwork and invoices, but my queries were promptly, professionally and thoroughly followed up.It's only been a couple of weeks and the weather has been fairly cloudy, but so far there's only been one day where we've used more from the grid than we've sent to the grid, so we're pretty happy that the system is meeting the outcomes we were hoping for.
Very professional company. Very organised. Great job done and very friendly . Would reccomend.

From initial  enquiry and quote, to install a battery to my existing PV system,  the whole process was seamless. Staff were knowledgeable and tradespeople turned up on time, were competent and well organised. The instsll was very neat and they left the work area cleaner than it was when they arrived.

At the start when getting a quote, they made it very easy to decide what was best for our house and how much power we would useThroughout every process from getting a quote to actual installation, everyone was very helpful, kind and informative! They even made sure to get in contact after to make sure everything was running smoothly

Do not hesitate to work with this amazing company.From the admin team, sales staff - Shout out to Robbie, who was very patient with my mother's 20 questions.There was clarity, transparency, and integrity every step of the way.Timely appointments meant we were up and running generating power for the grid in around 6 weeks.Please know this team value their customers and its evident in the quality and calabor of the business.
Solar Power Direct are a fantastic company to deal with!!They have just upgraded my original system (which they also installed)They are punctual easy to deal with and do their job well.
Everything, so far, has been done as promised.Meters have not yet been installed, but the appointment has been made.

I was hesitant at first about the investment of a solar system but we have a pool and up till last year the power bills didn't bother me. I was getting recently a $1490+ bill each quarter and that was high considering i was using a wholesaler for my electricity. Anyway I had 3 quotes and two were from companies who pretended to be in SA but who's offices were actual residential addresses and not offices as such. my 3rd quote from Solar Power Direct (SPD) in Grange Rd, Welland had an actual office which I drove by and checked out. Products inside to view and inspect, staff and clean and tidy.All their staff were great and not in any way pushy. They did a proper quote and evaluation of my house roof space and use the latest technology to predict the system output verses my usage. After that they sent a team of qualified in house electricians (two of them) to inspect the roof and measurements and make any adjustments needed prior to the install date.I used their office to sign and inspect the products that were going on the roof. The warranties seemed really long so I was impressed.On the day they installed we had no nasty surprises. It was done very nicely and again by in house (SPD) electricians. No sub contractors.We waited about a week or so for the Electricity provider to upgrade our old electric meter to a digital one which cost us $150 approx.We have had it 3 months now and heading into summer and have been continually impressed with the power generated each day. We have a pool and I wanted an improvement to our electricity bill. Our bill has been reduced by about $1000 a quarter and possibly in summer I think we will be in credit. the system will take approx 2 years to pay for itself in actually money expenditure terms but we are delighted by the design of the system as we do have an awkward layout with shading issues.Would I recommend these people?. YES YES YES I would. very decent and professional team and company. Thank you so much Solar Power Direct from Philip Rosewater 5013
The installer were good got it done in a day. The sales person were knowledgeable and helpful.

Absolutely fantastic team. From initial quote to installation and post installation, they made the process seamless. Special thanks to John and his team of installers. They were very professional and left no mess behind. 5 star performance.
From initial contact through to job completion SPD we're fantastic. Biting the bullet to get Solar can be daunting, not with these guys,extremely highly recommended
From getting the original quote, revising with new requirements, and final install, everything has been simple, straightforward, and no hassles. We are very happy with the system so far.
Every thing was done as promised, very good communication and timing despite the inclement weather conditions.

The entire team made the whole process absolutely seamless and easy. Sales team was very patient and knowledgeable in explaining options and quotes without heavy handed sales ‘tactics’. Very competitive pricing.Admin team- very helpful and prompt to respond.Installer- professional, swift. Connection to grid made so very easy.After sale support excellent.Couldn’t recommend the team more highly!

I wanted to take a moment to express my gratitude and satisfaction for the exceptional solar installation and service that Solar Power Direct have provided. I am extremely happy with the work that has been done and would like to share my feedback.The solar installation was completed in a timely and efficient manner, and the team was knowledgeable, professional, and courteous throughout the process. The attention to detail and quality of workmanship were evident from start to finish, and I was impressed by the level of care that was taken to ensure everything was done to the highest standard.The ongoing service and support that Solar Power Direct have provided has been equally impressive. Any questions or concerns I had were promptly addressed, and the follow-up service has been outstanding. I truly appreciate the peace of mind that comes with knowing that I can count on Solar Power Direct to provide prompt and reliable service whenever it is needed.Overall, I am thrilled with my solar installation and the level of service that has been provided. I would not hesitate to recommend Solar Power Direct to anyone looking for a high-quality solar installation and exceptional service.Thank you again for everything!SincerelyChris
Everything was so easy, great team and communication. Great job, would use them again.Thanks.

Service was great from start to finish. Our installer (Myles) was incredibly helpful with set up and very tidy. The customer service was second to none, would definitely recommend everyone go with this company.

The sales quoting process was straightforward and easy to understand. The installation was completed, on time, on budget, and without any issues. The installers cleaned up, so no fuss and no muss. All notifications to the grid were conducted and the system is functioning as promised. My wife and I would highly recommend the service provided by Tarik and the workers from Solar Direct.

From start to finish, Solar Direct help me chose the right battery for my purposes.  The customer service was exceptional and the installation team very professional.  The thing I really appreciated was that Solar Direct designed a battery setup that was not based on selling the most expensive product, but what was actually fit for my purposes.  I would recommend this company to anyone who is exploring the idea of purchasing a house battery.
Excellent management team, installers were early both days and completed works on time. System works great. Great after sales service. Highly recommend

The process was very efficient and went smoothly from getting the quote to installation. The sales team answered all my questions promptly and explained to me how it all worked. The installation process was quick and only took a day and the company helped me with the process of grid connection and getting in contact with my electricity company.
The sales process and information was fantastic. It took two goes to get the installation completed due to weather but we are up and running now!

Had early difficulties with other solar power companies due to our roof needing special care during installation.After multiple knockbacks a colleague suggested Solar Power Direct. Glad I listened!The team at Solar Power Direct were understanding and knowledgeable from the start of the process, and were able to adjust their install method for our roof.Pricing was reasonable, with good quality Risen panels and a Fronius inverter. Didn't try to oversell, didn't push batteries and we were able to eliminate the need for optimisers.Quoting, acceptance and payment method was smooth and easy and the installation was scheduled faster than i could have hoped for (before going away) and the lads were punctual, efficient and super friendly. I liked that the installers were part of the larger Solar Power Direct team (no 3rd parties).After sales service and assistance with the meter change etc was also very good.Overall, couldn't hoped for a better outcome and a great experience. Thanks again, team :-)
Quick response from sales staff and very detailed quotes.Good tradesman who cleaned up after themselves with an eye for detail.
Very helpful with available options easy quotation process and quick turnaround for install.

My journey was bit weird one as my construction completion took agesSolar Power Direct and team were very patient and helpful during this journeyDirected me to right places and contact to keep my subsidy going by providing documentsHelpful with finance support with PlentiInstallation was very smooth and the tradies were very courteous and polite when they were here and explained everything what’s happeningAll in all an excellent service from the teamAppreciate your help guys
The whole process was done in a day and they cleaned up afterwards. You wouldn't even known they were here.
Very professional installation and excellent customer service and communication. Have done a great job and for technical support they go above and beyond.

My data logger was replaced under warranty. Fantastic service by all at Solar Power Direct. They analysed the problem in their first visit and were back within a week to replace the faulty item.Great service and all staff are pleasant and professional to deal with. I wouldnt use anyone else other than Solar Power Direct.
I have used them twice now on two different propertiesThe installers were fabulous, polite and helpful

After the initial phone call Adrian made time to visit and explained the process and answered all questions I had unlike other providers who just send quote via email. Would thoroughly recommend Solar Power Direct.

So pleased to have had Solar Power Direct complete the process of installing my panels and battery system. The quoting was carried through with an inspection and discussion around what is suitable for the system to function at its optimal. The type of battery that suits the demand was evaluated and installed in a ideal location. Instillation was completed quickly and the monitoring of the system discussed clearly. A very professional process was carried out. I highly recommend this company to install sustainable solar power in your home.
Very good service and back up iwent local and could not be happier with solar power direct  good sales knowledge and honesty.

Installation was efficient however system already deteriorated after half a year, Solar Power Direct is not interested in addressing the issue. One month of emailing back and forth, phone call and all, no solution, just promises of 'letting the head electrician know' and 'getting back to you'.Lack of communication courtesy.Lack of knowledge on solar system performance from Admin team.Lack of post-sale service.Given workmanship warranty is for 10-year, I don't understand why this isn't addressed and rectified.

Solar panels were installed in 2013 by Solar Power Direct, and in 2021 there was a manufacturing fault on the panel which was still under warranty. The team at Solar Power Direct sent a technician to diagnose the problem and organise replacement of all the panels. This is a small family run business, and their customer service and communication was excellent. The replacement of all panels were installed without a hitch. I will be sure to recommend Solar Power Direct to anyone looking to install solar systems.
We are extremely pleased with the results and service.happy to recommend this company.
From the original quote to completion of the install, we could not fault the professionalism, communication and overall customer service.  We would definitely recommend Solar Power Direct.
I had a positive experience using Solar Power Direct from my initial enquiries right through to the installation process.  Would recommend to anyone.
Everyone I had spoken to from receptionist, Trades and Owners knew what they were takling about.Trades were professional and quick. Neat clean installation.Thank you everyone  Good job done.Susanne
I got some great quotes from great companies who were very helpful.

We purchased a Tesla Powerwall 2 from Power Solar Direct. Everything was smooth and straight forward from the beginning to after installation. The only hiccup was that the communication between Power Solar Direct and Plenti was somehow broken and all government grant allocations had been taken up so we were forced to go to the lower grant tier. Power Solar Direct in the end accepted the quote with the loss towards themselves (we had to fork out another $262 extra though), but this would’ve been prevented if the communication was clearer.

Extremely happy with this company. From the first point of contact to some questions I had after the installation they were extremely professional and responsive. The installation team was first class, well presented and did an amazingly neat job I cannot fault.

Very professional from beginning to end. Steve is an  excellent salesperson. My installation was stuffed up a little but Paul (MD) made sure that its done on time. Installation team was nice and friendly.

i had the experience of dealing with Steve as a sales person who was prompt and professional in his dealings, i further recommended 2 more friends and Steve provided us with an unmatched deal with an amazing customer service. The thing i loved the most was that i was'nt pastured with phone calls and emails once i was quoted the price like other solar companies and forced to make a decision ASAP, rather Steve was patient in answering all my queries. The company has its own in house technicians and installers which was one of the reason to go with them. I had a direct chat with the owner Paul as well who had taken out time to resolve any queries or concerns that i might have had. Great experience and a no hassle install.

Preliminary research indicated that the sola installation was as important a factor as was the panels and inverter.I chose Solar Power Direct after informative discussions with their representative Adrian Hansen.Adrian presented a comprehensive picture of what I needed  re panel selection and positioning and the best choice of Inverter.The installation was conducted by SPDirect  employees (not Sub Contracters) which was aligned with the company's high standards,I have no hesitation in recommending Solar Power Direct to those considering similar installations.GarryWest Lakes

Solar Power Direct were recommended to us by 2 other customers in our street, The whole process was easy with no high pressure salespeople. Installation was completed on the day designated and its operation explained.

I did quite a bit a bit of research and sourced a number of quotes. Solar Power Direct came out ahead in all aspects of my decision making. Knowledgeable sales person, as I had done so much research I had a number of â€œtrickyâ€ questions. Great install, clean, tidy and very detailed handover. Office team sent through information pack and all detailed as promised too. I canâ€™t recommend this company highly enough. Well gone guys !!!
I have nothing but praise for Solar Power Direct. Great price, excellent workmanship, excellent support staff.

Sales consultant was great. Answered all questions and provided appropriate information. At no point did I feel I was being pressured of upsold. All correspondence afterwards was polite and promptly felt with any issues.My own misunderstanding of some of the process lead to a slight delay (my mistake) and Solar Power Direct went out of their way to solve the issue.Installation went smoothly and quickly with little disruption. Electricians were polite and tidied up afterwards.Systems works great!

We considered this company in our 4 quote process initially due to our neighbour's recommendation.So glad we did, because the sales consultant Martina was pleasant and knew what she was talking about...no BS and was upfront with everything. Attention to detail and a credible installation plan on our roof as well.We did our research with SolarQuotes, so were armed with questions that needed to be asked. A quality system and install combined with a sharp price was our aim, and we got exactly what we were after!ALL connection and allied paperwork was attended to with no hassle by hard working Ruth, who constantly kept in touch regarding readiness and the install itself was fast, tidy and with a minimum of fuss by fully qualified tradesmen who actually work for the company....NO subcontractors!Solar Power Direct is a company i will have NO HESITATION in recommending to anyone who wants a system and installation second to none....

Solar Power Direct made the whole process seamless from quote through to installation and commissioning of the system.The job was completed on the day promised with professional installers and Electrcian and the site left tidy. A really pleasing experience.

Quoting was good and we were able to negotiate a price we were happy with. The whole process was easy. We were well informed, everything happened as they had explained and on time. Everyone we dealt with was polite and helpful. We were very happy with our choice.

A top experience from initial contact through to completion. From quotation through to acceptance was flawless with Jason willing to advise, alter and confirm matters at the slightest request. Installation was on time, with no fuss and the system operated without any problems from the moment it was switched on. Installers were professional, in contact with the smallest of questions and left details for immediate contact if required. I could not ask for anything better.
Very comprehensive explanation of Solar options and return on investment.Efficient sales process, plus timely installation and left property very clean and tidy. Competitively priced.
From quote to installation and clean up excellent on all counts

From my experience strongly recommend do not use this company. Their after sales service is non existent very very slow they even threaten to charge on a warranty fault of the inverter that's only 8 months old?? Excellent service, fantastic advice (could not be more helpful), so easy to deal with, great value for money and great work!!  Thank you so much.

The Delta hybrid inverter installed by Solar Power Direct over 12 months ago has been excellent in its overall operation.After sales service has been very good along with a resent upgrade of solar panels to take the existing system up to 4kw being good value for money.
I am very satisfied  with quality of system and installation.  Also very have with questions and support provided about performance of system.Thanks again Tony
The service was great, we didn't need to do anything, it was all taken care of.Great email contact.No issues what's so ever

Direct Solar Power were fantastic in lead up, sales and installation of our panels. No problem at all. Very impressed with everything  re our purchase. We are yet to see if it works as our energy provider Energy Australia are not turning up, making excuses re connecting and continually fob us off re when they are going to connect and turn it on. They have breached the requirements re connection time. We have now involved the Ombudsman who has been fantastic with helping us. Hopefully Energy Australia get their act together soon and connect the system. Wouldnt recommend Energy Australia but 10/10 for Direct Solar Power installation and have recommended them to everyone!
I didn't have a clue about the inverter until I read the manual.
Overall very happy with the quality and service provided. Thank you
I would recommend this company to everybody for their professional approach, the quality of solar system and installation.

The sales person was really good at his job and did well in showing us everything that would happen in a timely manner. Installation process was quick and easy. The installers were a good bunch of fellas with the electrician at the end giving me a brief on how to operate the system and read the meter.

I can genuinely say that my experience with Solar Power Direct was excellent from the quote process to the installation.I checked with a number of companies both locally and interstate and found that for quality, best price (very competitive) and local knowledge, this company was the best.The Salesperson Jason, took the time to answer all my queries regarding location of the inverter (Fronius), whether there was any potential noise issue, and location of the panels.  He was very good and came across to me as very transparent in his appraisal. This was the deciding factor along with being a local company in SA. When it came to the fitting of the panels (Lingo 300w Mono) and inverter, the Installers were excellent.  They listen to where I wanted the inverter and made sure I was happy with their work.  Since the installation I have been generating 40kw/h on a clear day and 16-20kw/h on a cloudy day. I am very happy with the work, the admin support and all round performance. It was a very good price as well! I would be the first to say if this company did not do what it had quoted but I am very happy.  I would highly recommend them to anyone who wasn't sure about what company to go to for Solar.

Installers turned up on time. Company provided continued support and assistance throughout and after the process. Prices were the same/similar as other companies, but perosnalised service made us go with SPD.

Was very happy with service
I wil use them again

Martina came to my home to discuss the in's and out's - the only company to do this. Not only was the price great (after researching about a dozen companies), but the panels were the best on the market and the installers were fantastic on the day. System was installed within a couple of weeks and the follow ups from the office have been great. 10/10 - highly recommended.

When You need to get a job done on your property  all you want is for the contractor to do as they say in a timely manner.Solar Power Direct did all of that. Their installation team together with their office support were top.I have already recommended them to some of family.

Martina the sales consultant was great, and the system was installed within a couple weeks. Took longer for the smart meter to be installed, but that was all to do with my electricity supplier.Solar Power Direct couldn't have made the transition to solar any simpler.

The two tradies who undertook the installation were well presented, courteous and went about their work in a professional manner. Arrived on time, went about the job promptly and cleaned up afterwards.
A stunning well sited system that has produced large amounts of power even on cloudy wintery days.

I was only contacted by 2 suppliers who continued to email and call even though I asked for time to evaluate their proposals. We did not want to be pushed into making a hasty decision given the amount of money we were spendingOne sales person insisted  my husband needed to be with me when he explained  his proposal. Unfortunately this was not appropriate for us. When he finally explained his proposal, it did not take into account potential winter shading of our roof from a neighbors tree until I pointed it out and then suggested that I ask the neighbour to prune it.  There were some other things thatThe other sales person pushed a really big system. He kept emailing asking if we were going ahead with his proposal but did not reply once I emailed back that we could not afford this amount so would not be going ahead with his companyâ€™s proposal.As only 2 suppliers contacted me I did some research on your site and contacted Solar Power Direct as their business is quite close to where I live.  The sales person asked me many questions (many more than any of the others) and sent me quotes for several different sizes and priced systems with written explanations of differences and did not push for a decision. They we also available to discuss issues after hours which was really helpful for us but not provided by the other companies. The sales person stopped in at our house to take photos of the house and electricity  meter And assisted with all applications. Their installers were quick, polite, professional and extremely helpful.Would definitely recommend Solar Power Direct

Martina Maglio was the most knowledgeable representative, knew all the ins and outs.The 6.4 kW QpeakCells and Fronius Prima 5.0-1 Int have preformed as expected averaging 12.3kWh for the last 11 days, which are the worst days of the year for day light. (15 June to 25 June)

I was impressed with the information I received from you, and the follow up was excellent! Just a shame we had no joy from the quotes received.We are expecting it to be installed any day now. Holidays have meant that it was not possible before.

I  got quotes from two of the 3 installers recommended by solar quotes, Braemac and Westside. Didn't go with either,  Braemac weren't competitive enough, and I  had doubts about Westsides quality of work.  I was surprised I was only given middle rated installers by solar quotes,  I then just went to their  "leader board " where there were better rated installers that serviced all Adelaide including my area - got quotes from Greenlife solar, Adelaide  Solar and several others. Why wasn't I offered these first?Because I was lookingfor the best possible price but still quality components, I did more online searches and found Solar power direct, who offered a price  match service and quality components at competitive prices. Had on site meeting and spoke to an electrician rather than a salesman,  which I much preferred,  straight forward explanations,  good prices and products and a very tidy installation completed within 4 weeks. Highly recommend them and their head electrician.

What I have learnt from this process is that most solar installers have their particular brand of solar panels that they spruik. More often than not their panel brands are different making comparisons very difficult. As a result the consumer really needs to do their homework to decide which panels and installer provides the best value for money. This is where your website proved invaluable. In the end I stayed away from those companies that specialised in just solar energy because their quotes were much higher as they had to cover the costs of their sales staff. Their quotes were some $2,000 more expensive for the same panels and inverters! The best offers were from those businesses that did not just rely on solar energy for their sales. For example both Goliath Electrical and Solar Power Direct are Electrical Retail Businesses headed by Electricians or Master Electricians, and installing solar systems is only part of their overall business. Both companies had been installing solar systems for many years. In the end I went for Solar Power Direct based on price, quality of the system and experience of the installer. I purchased 5.72kw system with the latest G4 QCells and a SMA 5000 TL Inverter for $8,000. I was very happy with this price especially as I am getting the latest G4 QCell panels to hit the market. I hope to have the system installed sometime in July.

As I have said, due to delay in the meter install I have not yet been able to assess an accurate savings performance, but can say the indications are good as my last two bills were in credit. Should the results confirm the indications, the above ratings may well be better.

I was very unsure about what package would be best and which company to go through as I had sent off numerous quote requests online. I found when speaking to sales people the better companies asked quite specific questions, like about my roof space and how much I wanted to spend and how much I was wanting to save on my bill. After getting all my quotes it was easy to see which systems were the best value for money and explained the installation and rebate conditions.

Looked at many different brands of panels and inverters online and through friends who have them. Went with SPD because of products and price. The good service was a bonus and the techs turned up on time!
